mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline over 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a cooling labor market, prompting expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts that boost equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.5% condition over 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint condition (HOUST>1250 and RSAFS>480000) over 20-day returns is below 0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO < 104.0 in late-cycle expansion periods over 20-day returns is above -0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) in the prior quarter indicates a resilient economy, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 growth over 60-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in strong growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 250 indicates elevated inflation, increasing the likelihood of Federal Reserve monetary tightening that raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 250 over 20-day returns is above -0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market, potentially fueling wage inflation and triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes, which depress equity valuations and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint condition (PAYEMS>145000 and UNRATE<4.0) over 20-day returns is above -0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 0.8% signals an active policy stance that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 0.8 in tightening cycles over 20-day returns is above -0.03, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances.
